Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin addressed reporters after meeting Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar to submit a memorandum regarding the alleged sexual harassment of a woman IAS officer by a ruling party legislator from Kallakurichi. Stating that the DMK previously lodged a complaint with the Director General of Police seeking the immediate arrest of the legislator, he called for the investigation to be handed over to the Central Bureau of Investigation.
Thank you for watching our video!
